name: Release lint deny-list of [ORG]AIOC-TOM
source: blueprint Annex D item 19 and Annex E.15; the words a release part may not hold
owner: the Cell carrying [ORG]HOAC-TM, owner of TEST-TOM
change_rule: A word is added by a tested change. A word is removed only as change-fixed-test-or-threshold, signed by the Cell carrying [ORG]HOAC-TM.
matching: Words and phrases match on word boundaries, where a hyphen is part of a word: 'AI-or-human' is caught by A-P1, not by the word list. Whitespace inside a phrase matches any run of whitespace. Patterns are applied as written here.

A.applies_to: every release part, including the string values of the manifest, the design ledgers and the trace; in CI, docs/OUTPUT.md and the enum strings of contracts/tom-release.schema.json
A.exemption: A hit passes only when it is the organisation's own subject matter: it lies inside an element marked <!-- el:<ID> --> whose cited atoms contain the same word, case-insensitive. Never in the quality checks, the fixed framing of the Decision Package, the manifest's own fields or docs/OUTPUT.md.

entries.note: v1 widens the pattern of the change specification, \b(ai|human)s?\s*(-|/|or|and|vs\.?|versus)\s*(ai|human)s?\b, by an optional hyphen on each side of the joining word, so that 'AI-or-human' is caught, as the matching rule above requires.

B.applies_to: the human-readable release parts: every part except the manifest, the design ledgers and the trace
